fields.title: Cost arithmetic agrees for B; C is rounded and D has unallocated allowances
fields.evidence: B sums to USD 210000–685000 once, 70000–291000 per article and 420000–1558000 for three. C's literal 58.660260kg basis gives 936602.60–4583013.00, consistent with rounded 1–4.6M. Twice B's per-article lines gives D 140000–582000, not 150000–610000; the extra 10000/28000 is unallocated and cannot establish a tooling upgrade.
fields.proposed_fix: Expose contingencies, fabrication yield, edge reinforcement, transport/tax and the larger D rig as separate PROJECTION lines; retain no-quote status.

claim: Cost arithmetic agrees for B; C is rounded and D has unallocated allowances
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
